# A trait is inherited by every term below the one that declares it (see io.github.devbpm.linneo.Trait).
# Sources of the rules that read them:
#   - Article 29 Working Party, Guidelines on Data Protection Impact Assessment, WP248 rev.01 (endorsed by the
#     EDPB on 25 May 2018), section III.B.a: evaluation or scoring (criterion 1), systematic monitoring (3),
#     sensitive data or data of a highly personal nature (4: financial data, location data, communications and
#     private documents), data concerning vulnerable data subjects (7: children, employees, patients...).
#   - ENISA, Recommendations for a methodology of the assessment of severity of personal data breaches (2013):
#     data processing context (simple, behavioural, financial, sensitive) and ease of identification.
#   - GDPR article 21.2-3: the absolute right to object to direct marketing and the profiling related to it.
#   - GDPR articles 4.13 and 4.14: genetic and biometric data, which the AEPD's list under article 35.4 counts as
# Columns: kind (category, use or subject), key, traits separated by commas
